*MGT415 GDB ANSWER*

Part (a): Identification of PESTLE Categories
PESTLE analysis helps businesses identify external factors that may influence their operations and decision-making.
No.	External Factor	PESTLE Category
1	Government introduces new food safety regulations.	Legal
2	Environmental regulations restrict the use of plastic packaging.	Environmental
3	New AI-based ordering and payment technologies become available.	Technological
4	Customers increasingly prefer healthy and organic food.	Social
5	Rising inflation reduces consumers’ purchasing power.	Economic
6	Government implements a new taxation policy for the hotel industry.	Political

Part (b): Effects of Rising Inflation on Hotel Operations
Rising inflation increases food, electricity, salaries, and maintenance costs. It reduces customers’ purchasing power, potentially lowering hotel bookings and restaurant sales. Management may adjust prices, control expenses, and adopt cost-effective strategies to maintain profitability.
